## 17. Use of staff car for private purposes  
[ Swamy's Staff Car Rules]  
1. The use of staff cars for non-duty journeys is completely banned.
2. Entitled Officers are allowed the use of official cars for private purposes up to 500 km per month on payment of~ 3,000 per month and
3. also foregoing the entitled Transport Allowance. 1181
